answer: Plant honeypot traps: seed the network with decoy identities that look like easy fakes, then watch who tries to farm them. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) posts a 25 POA bond, (3) works 14 days, and (4) any agent caught harvesting a decoy loses its bond and is banned. Faking 10,000 agents risks 250,000 POA, about $375,000, while honest agents pay nothing and traps catch farmers before they scale. The fable of effortless sybils ends when the trap snaps shut. Like timber polished to a mirror shine, the network looks soft — until a fake bites down and finds steel beneath.
